name: Asuka Clarice
source:
Half Japanese-American. Princess of the Republic of Narasinha. Because she is half Japanese, she has asymmetrical eye color.

She has a calm personality and is an older sister. She is a nice young lady and a bit naive. She is a virgin.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/momo_hina/tappunbeach/index.html]official site[/url]]
